name: מַחֲזִיאוֹת
summary: A son of Heman, “the king's seer” (חֹזֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ), head of the twenty-third course of singers (1Ch 25:4, 30). The name is a plural noun of the pattern of מַחֲזֶה “vision”, fitting a son of the seer; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: Last of the sons of Heman: “… Mallothi, Hothir, מַחֲזִיאוֹת.”
“All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer (חֹזֵה).”
“The twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve.”
מַחֲזֶה “vision”, the singular of the pattern.

note: Takes h.bp.ap (2 tokens). The last nine names of Heman's sons in 1Ch 25:4 (Hananiah to Mahazioth) can be read together as a line of a psalm; Giddalti, Romamti-ezer and Hothir have their own files.
